answer: Got it — saved as a standing rule: library crates use `thiserror`, binaries use `anyhow`, never swapped. I'll apply this automatically in future work on this codebase.

memories.content: In this codebase, library crates must use the thiserror crate for their error types, and binaries must use anyhow for their error types — never the reverse (never thiserror in binaries or anyhow in libraries). This convention has caused problems twice when violated.
